text: Keep map as a compatibility alias but make mapValues explicit. NeuroVol and NeuroVec expose coordinate-aware maps, NeuroVec and RoiSeries expose time-aware mapSamples, zipWith returns Either GridMismatch, and traverseValues uses Cats Applicative over an immutable Vector. No NeuroImage flatMap, Functor, or Monad instance was added because allocation requires ClassTag and image flattening has no coherent grid law.
